statuses.in-progress: Zero to 29 valid item ratings are present; no derived score is published.
statuses.completed: All 30 valid item ratings are present; subscales and total are derived by the server.
statuses.skipped: Assessment was not performed. No item ratings or derived scores are present, and skipped never means absent, normal, or favorable.

evaluationStates.incomplete: The exact missing PANSS item codes are returned; no authoritative score is published.
evaluationStates.passed: The assessment was explicitly skipped and no scores are inferred.
evaluationStates.completed: All 30 PANSS items are valid and authoritative scores were recomputed by the server.

legacyPassSemantics: The v1 passed value means skipped only. V2 never uses passed as a clinical result.

scoring.clientDerivedScores: Optional display projections are compared with the server result and rejected when malformed or mismatched; they are never authoritative.
